name: @pipeworx/mcp-worms

tools.name: search_species
tools.description: Resolve a marine species or genus name to its WoRMS AphiaID, accepted name, authority, status (accepted/unaccepted), rank, and high-level classification (kingdom/family/genus). WoRMS is the authoritative world register of marine species. Keyless.

name.description: Scientific name to look up, e.g. "Orcinus orca" or "Octopus".

marine_only.description: Restrict to marine taxa. Default true.

tools.name: get_classification
tools.description: Walk the full taxonomic lineage (root → tip) for a WoRMS AphiaID: returns a flat ordered array of { rank, name, aphia_id } from superdomain down to the taxon itself. Keyless.

tools.name: get_common_names
tools.description: Get common (vernacular) names for a WoRMS AphiaID across languages. Keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-worms forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the worms pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
